title: SMOK S2 Baby V2 Quadruple Sub Ohm Coils 0.15 Ohm
description: Designed for use with the Smok Stick series, these premium quality coils provide intense flavour and thick, flavoursome clouds of vapour when used with low wattage settings. The innovative mesh design of these coils allows for close contact with the core, which makes for less steeping time, more flavour and a longer coil lifespan. Featuring a quadruple coil for even heat distribution and exquisitely-smooth flavour, the Smok S2 Baby coils are suitable for use between 30 and 70 watts, but perform best when used at 45 to 60 watts.
